bugs.error_message: CORS error calling /api/google-reviews from Sanity studio
bugs.root_cause: next.config trailingSlash:true 308-redirects /api/google-reviews to /api/google-reviews/; browsers reject redirects on CORS preflight
bugs.fix: Call /api/google-reviews/ (with trailing slash) from studio and Netlify job

bugs.error_message: Sanity publish not visible on home page for up to an hour although /api/revalidate/ returns 200 {revalidated:'sanity'} (REVALIDATE=3600)
bugs.root_cause: revalidateTag(tag,'max') = stale-while-revalidate. On Netlify the edge is purged, the next request gets the STALE page entry, and that response is cached at the edge again with s-maxage=REVALIDATE minus its age (headers: cache-status hit ttl=3249, age 351, x-nextjs-date 4s after the webhook). With REVALIDATE=60 this self-healed within a minute and was masked.
bugs.fix: revalidateTag(SANITY_TAG, { expire: 0 }) in /api/revalidate and /api/google-reviews: entry is expired, next request does a blocking render with fresh data and that is what the edge caches.

bugs.error_message: /zakelijk/projecten/ filter shows Woningcorporaties project under VvE
bugs.root_cause: Filter used project.audience (seeded 'vve' for all) instead of category; two fields for the same thing drifted
bugs.fix: Filter on category->_id with buttons built from isZakelijk categories (like /projecten/); removed audience + filterVve/Corporatie/Bedrijf fields

bugs.error_message: On /zakelijk/projecten both 'Algemeen' and 'Projecten' nav links are highlighted
bugs.root_cause: isActivePath uses prefix match, so parent child link /zakelijk matches nested /zakelijk/projecten
bugs.fix: isActiveChild: within a dropdown only the longest matching child href is active

bugs.error_message: Sanity webhook revalidate works for one editor but not others; webhook attempts fail with resultCode null after 30s
bugs.root_cause: parseBody(req, secret, true) waits ~3s per call; Sanity delivers serially, so a bulk publish (~140 project docs) queued for minutes and later attempts timed out. Webhook URL also lacked trailing slash -> extra 308 per call.
bugs.fix: Removed wait arg from parseBody (reads use useCdn:false). Webhook URL should be /api/revalidate/ with trailing slash.

bugs.error_message: Studio 'Send test mail': Failed to fetch (mellow-bonbon-0520c6.netlify.app)
bugs.root_cause: Local studio had the new panel, but the deployed site had no /api/test-mail/ yet; its 404 has no CORS headers so the browser reports only 'Failed to fetch'
bugs.fix: Deploy the app (and set MAIL_TEST_SECRET) or point SANITY_STUDIO_SITE_URL at localhost:3000; panel error now names the likely causes

bugs.error_message: 502 Bad Gateway on POST https://schuijtklussenbedrijf.nl/api/submit-form/ after migrating Netlify -> Vercel
bugs.root_cause: The 502 is the route's own response when sendMail throws. Studio uses SMTP (smtp.transip.email:465 ssl) with smtpUser and smtpPassword empty, so both must come from SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASSWORD env, which were most likely not copied to Vercel (or only set for Preview). Without them TransIP rejects the unauthenticated send. Unconfirmed: Vercel logs not read (project not linked locally).
bugs.fix: No code change. Add SMTP_USER + SMTP_PASSWORD (and other Netlify env vars) to Vercel Production env, redeploy, check Logs for 'submit-form: sending failed'. Follow-up: resolveMailSettings now returns `missing` (env var names); submit-form/test-mail respond 500 'Mail (smtp) is not configured. Missing: SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD…' and on send failure 502 with the server's own error text. SMTP with ssl/starttls now requires user+password.

bugs.error_message: Sentry: TypeError: null is not an object (evaluating document.querySelector("meta[property=og:type]").content)
bugs.root_cause: pageMetadata returned openGraph: undefined (and description: undefined). Next merges metadata per key incl. explicit undefined, so the layout og:type/siteName was wiped on every page; a third-party script (in-app browser/extension) reads og:type and crashed.
bugs.fix: Only set keys that have a value; always return openGraph { type: website, images? }.
